[Which plan you need](/plan/), the [core actions](/plan/core-actions/), and the [program](/plan/program/) say what to do. This section holds what you fill in and keep while you do it, grouped by what you do with each item.

| Group | What you do with it | Start with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Records](/templates/records/) | Fill in and keep. Five records show what has been decided, asked, required, changed, and reviewed. Each has a blank table and a CSV, and one download holds them all. | The [register](/templates/records/register/), which every organization keeps |
| [Examples](/templates/examples/) | Follow. Two fictional organizations fill in the records: a marketing agency following the core actions, and a manufacturer running a full program. | [Stay on supplier updates](/templates/examples/stay-on-supplier-updates/) for the core actions; [Protect this first](/templates/examples/protect-this-first/) for a program |

## Sources

The templates set out the handbook's own method; the practices that fill them cite their sources.
